title: A New Artificial Intelligence Approach Using Extreme Learning Machine as the Potentially Effective Model to Predict and Analyze the Diagnosis of Anemia.
summary: An ELM classifies laboratory-confirmed anemia types in a held-out patient set; evidence supports diagnostic performance, not clinical benefit or external generalization.
ai_technology: ELM maps CBC features to four anemia classes, compared with laboratory reference diagnoses.
